## What this changes

A short description of the change and why it is needed. Link the issue if
there is one.

## Type of change

- [ ] Garden data correction or addition
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or improvement
- [ ] Translation or wording
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Dependencies or tooling

## For data changes

- Source URL(s):
- Date checked (YYYY-MM-DD):
- [ ] The Czech and English texts say the same thing, including any admitted gap
- [ ] Access, opening hours, entrance and participation are kept as separate facts

## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build:vercel` passes
- [ ] Keyboard operation, focus return and announcements still work (for interface changes; describe what you tried)
- [ ] Nothing autoplays and nothing collects data
- [ ] No fake states, invented users or statistics were added

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything you could not verify, or trade-offs you made.
